title.zh: 【韩国决定再次推迟加密资产征税】
title.en: 【韩国决定再次推迟加密资产征税】

current_state.zh: South Korea's presidential office has decided to postpone the crypto asset income tax slated for January 1, 2027, with ruling-party amendments proposing a 2029 start and final legislation expected during November's tax review.
